name: operator_non_urban_event
description: An operator that also runs Metro reports an event concerning only its conventional railway division.

candidates.title: Integrated rail operator upgrades conventional intercity signalling
candidates.search_snippet: An integrated rail operator upgraded signalling on its intercity division.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic operator engineering release. The publisher operates both a city Metro and a conventional intercity railway, but this event concerns only the intercity railway division and its mainline signalling corridor. No eligible urban-rail action is described.

contract_notes: Operator identity alone is not Scope proof; the event itself is conventional intercity rail.
